FLAGELLANT-STRESS_POWER.title: Stress
FLAGELLANT-STRESS_POWER.description:
When you gain 10 [gold]Stress[/gold], enter a random [blue]Resolute[/blue] or [red]Meltdown[/red] state.
Flagellant will only enter [gold]Toxic[/gold].
FLAGELLANT-STRESS_POWER.smartDescription:
Enter a random [blue]Resolute[/blue] or [red]Meltdown[/red] state after gaining 10 [gold]Stress[/gold].
Flagellant will only enter [gold]Toxic[/gold].

FLAGELLANT-TOXIC_MELTDOWN.title: Toxic
FLAGELLANT-TOXIC_MELTDOWN.description:
[gold]Flagellant's Exclusive Meltdown[/gold]
When entering [gold]Toxic[/gold], character's current HP will be set to 45% of their max HP, and gain 2 [gold]Scourge Form[/gold].
Whenever you deal attack damage, apply an equal amount of [gold]Poison[/gold]. Exit this Meltdown at the start of your next turn.

FLAGELLANT-TOXIC_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you deal attack damage, apply an equal amount of [gold]Poison[/gold]. Exit this Meltdown at the start of your next turn.
FLAGELLANT-COMBO_POWER.title: Combo
FLAGELLANT-COMBO_POWER.description: Some cards deal additional effects to a target with [gold]Combo[/gold], then remove this Token after those effects take effect.
FLAGELLANT-COMBO_POWER.smartDescription: When targeted, triggers additional effects of cards.
